subject.title: [Feature]: Settings should show gateway host + system info (hostname, IP, CPU, RAM, load, disk)

question: Should gateway host identity and host resource metrics become a core Control UI Settings quick card, or should the existing Instances/system-presence surface remain the canonical host-identity path?
rationale: The feature is feasible but creates new gateway protocol/UI surface and exposes host/network/resource details, while partially overlapping an existing operator-read presence surface.

options.title: Add Settings host card
options.body: Implement a narrow operator-read host-info endpoint and Settings quick card, reusing existing host identity, LAN, and disk helpers without adding the data to hello/status/health.

options.title: Extend Instances only
options.body: Keep Settings lean and add any missing resource metrics to the existing system-presence/Instances diagnostics path instead.

options.title: Defer core UI
options.body: Leave the issue open until stronger user demand proves this extra core diagnostics card is worth the protocol and UI surface.

recommendation.title: Add Settings host card
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow operator-read host-info endpoint and Settings quick card, reusing existing host identity, LAN, and disk helpers without adding the data to hello/status/health.
